name: openbook
description: OpenBook Studio monorepo — Book Model first. Not an EPUB editor.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @openbook/book-model && npm run build -w @openbook/validator && npm run build -w @openbook/semantic-document && npm run build -w @openbook/epub && npm run build -w @openbook/html && npm run build -w @openbook/pdf && npm run build -w @openbook/workflow && npm run build -w @openbook/importer && npm run build -w @openbook/desktop
scripts.test: npm test -w @openbook/book-model && npm test -w @openbook/validator && npm test -w @openbook/semantic-document && npm test -w @openbook/epub && npm test -w @openbook/html && npm test -w @openbook/pdf && npm test -w @openbook/workflow && npm test -w @openbook/importer && npm test -w @openbook/desktop
